reasoning: Shows a horizontal rectangular card containing three lines of text, which fits index cards, flashcards, cue cards, business cards, slides, or video captions. However, because it lacks a portrait, chip, or distinctive shape, it is somewhat generic and easily confused with generic document, text-box, or UI layout icons.
